newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-PacifiCorp 97 EPS view upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-PacifiCorp 97 EPS view upped.

text.p: Gruntal & Co analyst Penelope Adelmann raised her 1997 profit forecast for PacifiCorp on Monday to $1.67 from $1.60 and raised 1998 profit estimates to $1.86 from $1.75 after meeting with management.
-- continues to rate stock a buy for aggressive growth investors after its offer to buy Britain's Energy Group Plc .

-- said deal should be accretive from its closing. In the United Kingdom, the process should be complete by mid-September. Company expects very little regulatory interaction in the United States, she said.
-- Said PacifiCorp plans to sell its market-based trading operations in order to cut the number of U.S. regulatory approvals needed.
-- Said debt levels will rise for the $9.7 billion purchase. "Repair to the balance sheet is expected to take a few years," the report said.
-- PacifiCorp shares off 1/16 to to 22-9/16 after earlier touching a new 52-week high of 22-11/16.
-- Energy Group shares off 1/8 to 43-1/8 on the NYSE.
